prompt_text: Analyze Prompt666 project-level autonomy completion gate and propose Prompt667 for final end-to-end unattended project run acceptance. Preserve all safety constraints: no remote push, no PR creation, no merge, no destructive cleanup, no credential/cookie/browser-profile/.env/private-session access, and no arbitrary free-text prompt execution. Prompt667 must prove a small project goal through goal -> queue -> implementation -> validation -> evidence -> final report without human intervention during the bounded run before project_level_autonomy_complete may become true.
